title: Trail and Summit
author: Coral Halloran
blurb: Edmund Vane, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
